row.evidence: IT Glue's pricing page lists 'Single sign-on (SSO/SAML)' and 'Just-in-time provisioning for SSO' but no SCIM, and its help centre's only provisioning option is SAML JIT, which creates users 'the first time they access IT Glue using SSO'.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. No SCIM at any tier: the pricing page, the full help-centre sitemap (help.itglue.kaseya.com) and the API reference never mention SCIM or IdP push provisioning. Users can be auto-created by SAML JIT on first sign-in (the pricing cards grey out JIT on Basic and Select, so Enterprise $44), and are otherwise invited by admins. SAML SSO guides cover Okta, Entra ID, Google, OneLogin, ADFS, Duo and others using custom SAML apps; Okta's OIN 'IT Glue' app is SWA only (last updated Sep. 18 2017). Prices are per user per month on a 36-month term (billed monthly), 5-user minimum. The REST API (Enterprise only, so api_tax) can list/read/update users and manage groups but cannot create or delete users; GET /logs returns 30 days of activity logs.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: SSO/SAML is a normal (included) item on the card; JIT and IT Glue API Access are greyed out. Feature shown greyed out (text-light-grey) on Basic and Select in the pricing-card markup; included on Enterprise.

plans.name: Select
plans.notes: Feature shown greyed out (text-light-grey) on Basic and Select in the pricing-card markup; included on Enterprise.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented anywhere: none of the 3,312 help-centre sitemap URLs, the API reference or the pricing page mention SCIM. Marked false by absence; automation is SAML JIT only (c9), and without JIT 'We don’t create user accounts under SSO' (c31).

endpoints.purpose: Update a user's name or avatar
Update a group, including member user ids
Activity logs for the most recent 30 days

user_api.notes: JSON:API-style REST API. Users can be listed, read and updated (name/avatar, Allow All Organizations) but no create, invite, deactivate or delete user endpoint is documented; groups (with member user ids) can be created, updated and deleted.

okta.notes: OIN 'IT Glue' app is SWA only per page markup (last updated Sep. 18 2017). IT Glue's own guide sets up a custom SAML 2.0 app in Okta, so SAML works with Okta outside the catalogue app; row uses sso_only.

entra.notes: IT Glue's guide creates a custom enterprise app; Microsoft Learn it-glue-tutorial and itglue-tutorial returned 404.

onelogin.notes: From IT Glue's own OneLogin guide; OneLogin catalogue not checked.

fallbacks.notes: JIT assigns a default role, groups (matched from IdP group claims) and organization access. Deleting a user blocks login and keeps their actions in activity logs (c30).

conflicts.text: The pricing page shows SAML SSO as included on Basic and Select, but the 'Setting up single sign-on' article says SSO is for Administrators or Managers 'on an Enterprise plan'. Pricing page used for the plan gate.

The pricing cards grey out 'Just-in-time provisioning for SSO' on Basic and Select, while the JIT help article says it is for 'Basic with SSO 2021, Select with SSO 2021, and Enterprise plans' (older plan names).
